levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير

notes: Two branches meet at روح; the names after «قال أخبرنا روح» are written once and belong to both routes, so they are the shared tail.
The gloss «- واللفظ له -» is left out.
«أبيه» is a bare relation (father of عبد الله بن أبي بكر); the Companion Abu Humayd is the last link.
